entities.name: FecI sigma factor
observations: Exact sequence match to UniProt P23484 from Escherichia coli K-12; 173 aa, 100% identity and coverage.
FecI is an extracytoplasmic function (ECF) sigma factor that promotes bacterial RNA polymerase binding to specific promoters.
Curated function: activates transcription of the fecABCDE ferric citrate transport operon.
Curated interaction: the cytoplasmic N-terminus interacts with the anti-sigma factor FecR.
Predicted/annotated domains: Sigma70_r2 at residues 16-81, Sigma70_ECF at 42-158, and Sigma70_r4/r4_2 at approximately 112-164.
Curated DNA-binding region: helix-turn-helix motif around residues 139-158.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular weight approximately 19.48 kDa, theoretical pI 5.82, predicted charge at pH 7 approximately -3.14.

Gene Ontology annotations include bacterial-type RNA polymerase core enzyme binding, core promoter sequence-specific DNA binding, sigma factor activity, DNA-templated transcription initiation, regulation of DNA-templated transcription, and intracellular iron ion homeostasis.

entities.name: Ferric citrate uptake
observations: The fecABCDE operon mediates ferric citrate transport; its transcription is activated by FecI under the corresponding iron-acquisition regulatory system.

entities.name: FecR anti-sigma factor
observations: FecR is the membrane-associated regulatory partner reported to interact with the cytoplasmic N-terminus of FecI.
